the same arm under `flume friction --help`

summary: the cases with no structural substitute — a stat that fails after a readdir succeeds, a symlink loop, `ln -s`, a sh shim reached through one — red the lane on their fixture, not a defect
acceptance: every case whose subject is POSIX error semantics names its host and the reason it skips elsewhere, so the win32 lane's remaining reds are engine or fixture defects and nothing skips silently.
pins: no case in tests/ denies with a permission bit outside the declared-host list
every declared-host case carries the reason it cannot run on the other host
notes: The declared-host list is an allowlist with a reason each, on the `EXTERNAL_VOCABULARY` idiom (`tests/commentCitations.test.ts`): a site added without one is indistinguishable from residue. `harnessRunner`'s `ln -s` is also what `.claude/rules/platform-facts.md`, *pnpm deletes a symlinked `node_modules` on install* already says not to do. `bin/flume` is the sh shim; the published win32 bin is `bin/flume.js`, so the walk's subject is POSIX-only by construction.

edit.description: the two deep-nest fixtures build and run git through the namespaced join the cases themselves pin
the long pendingPath fixture, same

summary: the three win32 total-path cases nest their tree with a bare `join` and then run git in it, so the fixture hits the very limit the case exists to prove the engine clears
acceptance: each long-path case builds its fixture through `namespacedJoin` and reaches the engine call it names on win32, so the lane's verdict on these three is the engine's and not the fixture's.
pins: jobRm finds and removes a job whose dir nests past win32's ~260-char limit
jobNew doesn't misread an existing chain.ts or seedDir as absent when configDir/seedDir nests past win32's ~260-char limit
readPending/readPendingTolerant/commitPendingUpdate don't misread an existing or writable pending.json as absent when pendingPath exceeds win32's ~260-char limit
notes: Lane-observed: all three failed `spawn git ENOENT`, which is win32 refusing a cwd past the limit rather than a missing git. The idiom is the one the section names and the cases already exercise on the engine side. `job new` pins `core.longpaths` repo-locally on win32; a fixture that inits its own repo wants the same.

notes: 3b3dca4 accepted the double read as debt riding this entry: `undrainedRedLane` and `renderCiLanes` each walk every lane, and handing the render the liveness verdict is the same edit this sentence forces. `withMaterial`'s unread arm drops the failing status it degraded from, which is why the wake's cause cannot be named today.
